tracesTo: UserFlow: Manager / Fan Onboarding, Claiming & Role Assignment

stories.title: Manager Claims Team by Platform Username
stories.goal: claim my fantasy team by matching my platform username to a team in the league
stories.benefit: I can establish my identity as the manager of my specific team
acceptanceCriteria: System displays list of unclaimed teams from connected fantasy league
User can view team details including platform username/ID for each team
User can select their team from the list based on matching username
System validates that selected team's platform username matches user's platform identity
System creates manager role assignment linking user to selected team
System marks team as claimed and removes it from unclaimed teams list
User receives confirmation of successful team claim

stories.title: Manager Claims Team by Platform User ID
stories.goal: claim my fantasy team by verifying my platform user ID when username matching fails
stories.benefit: I can still claim my team even if username has changed or doesn't match exactly
acceptanceCriteria: System provides alternative claim method using platform user ID
User can view their platform user ID from their profile or external platform
System fetches and compares platform user IDs from fantasy league data
System validates user's platform ID matches team owner ID from external platform
System completes team claim if ID verification succeeds
System provides clear error message if ID verification fails with retry option
System logs claim attempts for security and audit purposes

stories.title: Fan Selects Fan Role Without Team Support
stories.goal: join the league as a fan without being tied to a specific team
stories.benefit: I can participate in league activities as a neutral observer
acceptanceCriteria: System displays role selection interface for users who don't own teams
User can explicitly select 'Fan' role option
System allows fan role selection without requiring team association
User can optionally skip team support selection during initial onboarding
System creates league membership with fan role and no team association
User is directed to appropriate fan experience after role selection
System tracks fan role for access control and feature availability

stories.title: Fan Selects Favorite Team to Support
stories.goal: choose a favorite team in the league to follow and support
stories.benefit: I can show my allegiance and receive team-specific content and notifications
acceptanceCriteria: System displays list of all teams in league during fan onboarding
User can select one team as their favorite/supported team
System stores fan's team preference in user profile
System allows fans to support teams that are already claimed by managers
System allows fans to support teams that are not yet claimed
User can see their selected team displayed in their profile and feed interactions
System uses team preference to personalize fan's experience

stories.title: Support Multiple Users Claiming Same Team
stories.goal: have multiple people associated with my team (co-managers, supporters)
stories.benefit: multiple people can collaborate or support the same team without conflicts
acceptanceCriteria: System allows one primary manager claim per team
System allows additional users to request secondary manager status for same team
System allows unlimited fans to support the same team
System clearly differentiates between primary manager, secondary managers, and fans in UI
System maintains team's primary manager identity for official actions
Secondary managers and fans see team-specific content and can interact with team posts
System tracks all user-team relationships for access control and features

stories.title: Validate Team Claim Against Platform Data
stories.goal: ensure team claims are legitimate and match external fantasy platform data
stories.benefit: only legitimate team owners can claim manager roles preventing impersonation
acceptanceCriteria: System fetches current team ownership data from external fantasy platform API
System compares claim attempt against current platform owner username or ID
System blocks claim if username/ID does not match platform data
System provides clear rejection message explaining validation failure
System allows claim if platform data confirms ownership
System handles edge cases where platform data is temporarily unavailable
System logs all claim validation attempts for security audit

stories.title: View Available Teams Before Claiming
stories.goal: see which teams are available to claim and which are already taken
stories.benefit: I can quickly identify my team or decide to join as a fan
acceptanceCriteria: System displays all teams from connected fantasy league
System clearly indicates which teams are already claimed vs available
System shows team name, logo, and platform username for each team
System displays current record and basic team info to help identification
System allows user to search or filter teams by name or username
Claimed teams show 'Claimed' status but still allow fan support selection
Unclaimed teams show 'Available to Claim' option for managers

stories.title: Handle Team Claim Conflicts
stories.goal: understand why my claim was rejected and what my options are
stories.benefit: I can resolve claim conflicts or choose an alternative role
acceptanceCriteria: System detects if team is already claimed by another user before processing new claim
System displays clear message that team is already claimed with claimant's basic info
System offers option to request secondary manager status if team is claimed
System offers option to join as fan supporting that team
System offers option to contact admins if user believes they are legitimate owner
System prevents duplicate primary manager claims for same team
System logs claim conflicts for admin review and dispute resolution

stories.title: Change or Update Team Support Preference
stories.goal: change which team I support after initial selection
stories.benefit: I can update my preferences if my allegiance changes or I made a mistake
acceptanceCriteria: User can access team preference settings from profile or settings page
User can view current team support selection
User can select a different team to support from available teams
System updates team preference immediately upon confirmation
System maintains history of team support changes for analytics
System updates user's feed and notifications to reflect new team preference
System allows user to remove team support and become neutral fan

stories.title: Request Secondary Manager Status for Team
stories.goal: request to be added as a secondary manager for a team that's already claimed
stories.benefit: I can collaborate with the primary manager if they approve my request
acceptanceCriteria: User can view claimed teams and see option to 'Request Co-Manager Access'
User can submit request with optional message explaining relationship to team
System notifies primary manager and league admins of secondary manager request
Request enters admin approval queue for review
User receives confirmation that request was submitted
System tracks pending secondary manager requests for admin processing
User can cancel pending request if needed

stories.title: Display Role and Team in User Profile
stories.goal: see my role and team association displayed in my profile
stories.benefit: other members can identify my role and team affiliation in the league
acceptanceCriteria: User profile displays role badge (Manager, Fan, Admin)
User profile shows associated team logo and name if applicable
Manager profiles display 'Manager of [Team Name]' designation
Fan profiles display 'Fan of [Team Name]' or 'Neutral Fan' if no team selected
Secondary managers show 'Co-Manager of [Team Name]' designation
Role and team info appears in user's posts, comments, and interactions
System uses role for styling and visual differentiation in UI

stories.title: Prevent Claiming After Initial Onboarding
stories.goal: prevent users from claiming teams after they've already joined as fans
stories.benefit: role assignments remain stable and prevent confusion about team ownership
acceptanceCriteria: System locks role selection after user completes initial onboarding
Users who joined as fans cannot later claim manager role for same league
System provides clear message if user attempts to claim after joining
Admin users can manually reassign roles if legitimate ownership needs change
System allows users to join as fans of teams they don't own without locking out legitimate owners
System tracks when role was initially assigned for audit purposes
System allows role changes through admin approval process only
